name: ultimate-junie-guideline-configurator
description: A centralized configuration and build system for the JetBrains Junie Agent. Create, manage, and merge Junie guidelines and examples effortlessly.

scripts.local: bun -e "const pkg = await Bun.file('package.local.json').json(); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(pkg.scripts[process.argv[1]], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
